a11yaudit.title: Accessibility audit — checkout flow

checks.label: Keyboard navigation
checks.note: Every control is reachable and operable with Tab and Enter.

checks.label: Focus order
checks.note: Tab order follows the visual reading order top to bottom.

checks.label: Colour contrast
checks.note: Placeholder text sits at 3.9:1 — below the 4.5:1 target for body copy.

checks.label: Image alt text
checks.note: All informative images carry descriptive alt; decorative ones are empty.

checks.label: Form field labels
checks.note: The promo-code input has no associated label, so screen readers announce it as "edit text".

checks.label: Touch target size
checks.note: The remove-item icon is 36px; bump to 44px to meet the minimum target size.

a11yaudit.footer: Two issues block the AA bar: the unlabelled promo field and the low-contrast placeholders.

usabilityfindings.title: Usability test — checkout flow

issues.label: Promo-code field has no visible label
issues.note: Four of six testers typed the code into the wrong field on the first try.

issues.label: Low-contrast placeholder text reads as filled-in
issues.note: Two testers skipped the field, assuming it already had a value.

issues.label: Remove-item icon is easy to miss on touch

usabilityfindings.footer: Both blockers trace to the same two components flagged in the audit above.
